newsitem.title: UK: Bookmaker cuts UK Conservatives, Dec election odds.
newsitem.headline: Bookmaker cuts UK Conservatives, Dec election odds.

text.p: British bookmaker Ladbrokes said on Friday it cut the odds on the ruling Conservatives winning the next general election to 7-4 from 2-1 following the party conference in Bournemouth this week.

It said odds on a December election had also been cut, following several large bets, to 8-1 from 100-1. May remains the most likely month and is quoted at 4-11. The election has to be held by mid-May.
The main opposition Labour party's odds on winning have been lengthened to 4-11 from 1-3. Ladbroke's said Friday had been its busiest day for political bets in recent months.
